ServiceCanadaCentre.heading: Get ready to visit a Service Canada Centre
ServiceCanadaCentre.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
ServiceCanadaCentre.step1: Select and enter your ID details
ServiceCanadaCentre.step2: Get your unique identification code; clicking Continue below will generate your code and send it to your email. It's valid for 30 days.
ServiceCanadaCentre.step3: Visit your nearest Service Canada Centre, bring your code and one valid government-issued photo ID.

ProvincialVerification.step1: Have your provincial partner app ready
ProvincialVerification.step2: Select the appropriate option and follow the steps to prove your identity
ProvincialVerification.step3: Once the proofing is complete, you will be automatically redirected
ProvincialVerification.learnMoreLink: Learn more about provincial identity proofing

OnlineVerificationInfo.heading: Get ready for selfie and ID check
OnlineVerificationInfo.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
OnlineVerificationInfo.step1: You will need one government issued photo ID
OnlineVerificationInfo.step2: Take a selfie and a photo of your ID in a well lit room using a mobile phone camera with a high resolution
OnlineVerificationInfo.step3: Confirm your submission and get your proofing results to continue
OnlineVerificationInfo.planForTime: Plan for about 5 minutes to complete this process.
OnlineVerificationInfo.learnMoreLink: Learn more about how selfie and ID check works
